reviews.text:
Hello to whom all is reading,
Q is an experienced Barber in all types and textures of hair and has been licensed for over 20 years and his work shows .

When I was a teenager, my friends and I would go and see Q as we thought of him as :
(AIR JORDAN ) of cutting hair, no one had the skills or style he had and his shop was always constantly busy.
Q THE BARBER had inspired me to become a barber from seeing his success and passion behind his work, to where later in life I went to school to become a barber and eventually open a well known shop in Southern California called ‘Justin’s Fades & Hairstyles’.

I flew into town from  Southern California to come and visit family, so I didn’t have the time to get my haircut before I flew in to town.
I reached out to Q and had made an appointment with him. He sharpened me up with a clean fade and sharp beard lines.
He deserves all the reviews and compliments as he demonstrates daily that they are well deserved.
reviews.author: Justin Balint

reviews.text: Best experience I've ever had. Q was patient and he actually listened to what I wanted. He's great with kids, and he is definitely the best barber I have ever come across. I would recommend everyone who needs a cut, to go to Q's corner barbershop.
reviews.author: Mike “MFDIESEL” Castaneda

reviews.text: Q is by far the greatest barber in Salem! Personable, friendly and genuine! I've been coming to Q for almost 11-12 years now! And that will continue for years to come!
reviews.author: Tony Lones

reviews.text: When you first walk in, you’re warmly welcomed. On time for appointments and excellent service/ haircut was exactly what I asked for him to do.
reviews.author: kelvin jackson

reviews.text: Excellent experience from start to finish. Q is a top-notch barbershop with a professional barber who pay great attention to detail. The fades are excellent, clean, sharp, and consistently on point. The shop is welcoming, well-run, and you can count on quality every visit. If you’re looking for a reliable, high-quality haircut, this is the place! Highly recommend!!
reviews.author: Mark Harris
